from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")

disc = repo / "jobpipe_discovery.py"
text = disc.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
text = text.replace(
    'elif any(v in title for v in ("software engineer", "backend", "full stack", "full-stack", "developer", "platform engineer")):',
    'elif any(v in title for v in ("software engineer", "software developer", "backend engineer", "backend developer", "full stack", "full-stack", "platform engineer", "java engineer")):',
)
text = text.replace(
    'elif any(v in title for v in ("intern", "internship")):\n        score -= 50\n        reasons.append("internship")',
    'elif any(v in title for v in ("intern", "internship")):\n        score -= 50\n        reasons.append("internship")\n\n    if "new grad" in title or "new graduate" in title:\n        score -= 30\n        reasons.append("new-grad program")\n    if "clinician" in title or "therapist" in title:\n        score -= 45\n        reasons.append("non-SWE primary role")'
)
disc.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

queue = repo / "jobpipe_queue.py"
text = queue.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
start = text.index("def enqueue_matched(")
replacement = '''def _role_key(company: str, title: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    def normalize(value: str) -> str:
        return (
            value.casefold()
            .replace("’", "'")
            .replace("‘", "'")
            .replace("–", "-")
            .replace("—", "-")
            .strip()
        )
    return normalize(company), normalize(title)


def enqueue_matched(csv_path: str = "", limit: int = 0) -> dict[str, Any]:
    home = PrivateHome.discover()
    paths = home.ensure()
    target = Path(csv_path).expanduser().resolve() if csv_path else paths.job_queue
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    jobs, _ = get_all_jobs(status="matched", sort_by="match_score", sort_order="desc", limit=limit or 10000)
    current = {}
    for job in jobs:
        company = str(job.get("company") or "").strip()
        title = str(job.get("title") or "").strip()
        url = str(job.get("apply_url") or job.get("url") or "").strip()
        if not company or company.casefold() == "unknown" or not title or not url:
            continue
        key = _role_key(company, title)
        score = int(job.get("match_score") or 0)
        candidate = {
            "company": company,
            "job_title": title,
            "job_url": url,
            "priority": _priority(score),
            "status": "Pending",
            "resume_variant": "",
            "source": str(job.get("source") or job.get("platform") or ""),
            "match_score": str(score),
            "notes": str(job.get("reasoning") or ""),
        }
        previous = current.get(key)
        if previous is None or score > int(previous.get("match_score") or 0):
            current[key] = candidate

    preserved: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    if target.is_file() and target.stat().st_size:
        with target.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
            reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
            for row in reader:
                if row.get("status", "").strip().casefold() != "pending":
                    preserved.append(dict(row))

    rows = preserved + list(current.values())
    with target.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=FIELDS)
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)

    target.chmod(0o600)
    return {
        "queue": str(target),
        "matched_considered": len(jobs),
        "pending_rows": len(current),
        "preserved_non_pending": len(preserved),
        "total_rows": len(rows),
    }
'''
text = text[:start] + replacement
queue.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

print("tightened role/new-grad false-positive filters")
print("enqueue now rebuilds pending queue from current matches")
